scripts.test:research: cd research && uv run python -m unittest discover -s tests -v
scripts.test:native: cmake -S native -B build/native -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release && cmake --build build/native -j 8 && ctest --test-dir build/native --output-on-failure
